_about: Authored Surf and rod species in native slot order, reconciled against Inclement and the pre-rebase habitat design. This sheet owns water species; wild_encounters.json owns levels and encounter rates. Region/cap are historical authoring context, NOT physical access gates or encounter levels. Land and Rock Smash species are authored directly in wild_encounters.json.

MAP_ROUTE103.why: Coastal channel: shore birds, Shellos and Wiglett with early Remoraid; later fishing adds shellfish and larger marine residents.

MAP_ROUTE102.why: Freshwater shallows: retain Inclement Corphish/Goldeen fishing; Surf adds pond residents, while later rods broaden freshwater teams.

MAP_PETALBURG_CITY.why: Freshwater town pond: early Magikarp/Marill; Surf introduces Lotad and Wooper, and later rods offer freshwater evolutions.

MAP_ROUTE104.why: Briney coast: keep Inclement Wingull as the common Surf resident, restore Wiglett and coastal invertebrates, and make Skrelp an early kelp-bed catch.

MAP_DEWFORD_TOWN.why: Island shallows: early Mantyke pairs with Route 106 Remoraid; retain Inclement shellfish through later rods and preserve the coastal Surf habitat.

MAP_ROUTE106.why: Rocky coast: Remoraid supports nearby Mantyke; retain Inclement early Clauncher, with Skrelp already available on Route 104. Binacle and Wiglett distinguish Surf.

MAP_ROUTE105.why: Western sea: retain Inclement Clauncher/Skrelp fishing, while authored Wishiwashi, Clamperl and Mantine distinguish Surf from the adjacent coast.

MAP_ROUTE107.why: Fast-swimmer channel: authored Arrokuda and Floatzel share the water with Inclement Mantyke; Finneon fishing preserves the native coastal family.

MAP_ROUTE108.why: Shipwreck approach: retain Inclement Frillish and Finneon; authored Lapras and Dhelmise make exploration of the wreck waters distinctive. Lapras is a 2% ordinary Surf discovery here, with more plentiful later cold-water homes.

MAP_ROUTE109.why: Sandy beach: Shellos and Wiglett occupy the shallows; fishing retains a small-fish foundation and later adds shellfish and coastal predators.

MAP_SLATEPORT_CITY.why: Harbor: retain Inclement Horsea/Frillish early fishing to distinguish the port from neighboring beaches; later rods add their evolutions and wreck-associated Dhelmise.

MAP_ROUTE110.why: Estuary beside the cycling road: early Tadbulb and Chinchou supply Electric options; Surf and later rods develop the brackish-water population.

MAP_ROUTE111.why: Inland ponds: retain Inclement Barboach/Goldeen fishing and Basculin; authored Wooper, Palpitoad and larger freshwater residents expand later methods. Dratini is a 2% ordinary Surf visitor here; Meteor Falls remains its principal habitat.

MAP_ROUTE114.why: Mountain river and Good Rod gift: preserve Inclement Wishiwashi/Barboach and Quagsire; authored Buizel, Basculin and Shellos diversify the river.

MAP_ROUTE115.why: Northern rocky shore: retain Inclement Wishiwashi/Wailmer fishing; authored Krabby, Barbaracle and Shellos distinguish Surf, with Wailord on the later rod.

MAP_ROUTE117.why: Day-Care ponds: authored Paldean Wooper and Tympole give the early inland route a distinct niche; retain Inclement Corphish through the Good Rod.

MAP_ROUTE118.why: River mouth: retain Inclement Tentacool and Carvanha alongside authored Shellos and Basculin; Aqua Tauros is a later Surf discovery, not an opening fishing catch.

MAP_ROUTE119.why: Rainforest river: retain Inclement eastern Gastrodon and Floatzel, with Poliwag and Tympole. Feebas is exclusive to the original seeded fishing spots, using any rod; ordinary tables do not contain it. Feebas evolves into Milotic; the ordinary tables do not offer Milotic directly.

MAP_ROUTE120.why: Rain-fed ponds: preserve Inclement Stunfisk, Azumarill and Masquerain; authored Chewtle and later freshwater evolutions expand the local team options.

MAP_ROUTE121.why: Coastal wetlands: preserve Inclement Pelipper, Frillish, Alomomola and Wailmer rather than replacing the sea with an inland pond; authored Swanna joins Surf.

MAP_ROUTE123.why: Freshwater ponds: retain Inclement Goldeen/Corphish fishing; authored Buizel, Swanna, Seismitoad and Chewtle make the return route distinct.

MAP_ROUTE122.why: Mt. Pyre waters: retain Inclement Frillish and Wailmer; authored Chinchou, Lapras and later Ghost-water residents reinforce the offshore graveyard habitat.

MAP_LILYCOVE_CITY.why: Eastern port: preserve Inclement Finneon, Staryu and Bruxish fishing; authored Cramorant, Pyukumuku and Lapras distinguish the bay from Slateport.

MAP_ROUTE124.why: Eastern open water: retain Inclement Jellicent and Alomomola, with authored Clamperl and Finizen; later rods develop the shellfish family.

MAP_ROUTE125.why: Shoal approach: retain Inclement Jellicent and Finneon, but restore the authored cold-water Spheal, Dewgong and Lapras habitat outside the cave.

MAP_ROUTE126.why: Sootopolis outer reef: keep Inclement Alomomola and Sharpedo; authored Wishiwashi and Mantine broaden Surf, with Aqua Tauros reserved for the later rod.

MAP_ROUTE127.why: Eastern reef: retain Inclement Alomomola and Frillish fishing while restoring the authored Mareanie, Pyukumuku and Bruxish niche.

MAP_ROUTE128.why: Seafloor approach: preserve Inclement Luvdisc/Corsola fishing and Jellicent/Alomomola Surf; authored Wailmer and Finizen diversify the offshore route.

MAP_MOSSDEEP_CITY.why: Super Rod port: keep Inclement Floatzel and Finneon, with authored Cramorant, Staryu and Finizen; the new rod immediately offers Starmie and larger marine partners.

MAP_EVER_GRANDE_CITY.why: League coast: keep Inclement Tentacruel, Luvdisc and the Mareanie family; authored Mantine, Pyukumuku and Lapras distinguish this final mainland shore.

MAP_ROUTE129.why: Southern open sea: retain Inclement Tentacruel, Alomomola and Wailord; authored Lapras and deep-water rod residents reward the longer sea route.

MAP_ROUTE130.why: Southern channel: keep Inclement Alomomola and Wailord, add authored Frillish and Wishiwashi, and reserve the unusual Hisuian fish for the Super Rod.

MAP_ROUTE131.why: Ancient southern reef: retain Inclement Tentacruel and Lumineon; authored Clamperl and Relicanth establish the habitat, with Omastar and shellfish evolutions on the Super Rod.

MAP_PACIFIDLOG_TOWN.why: Floating village: preserve Inclement Skrelp fishing and Dhelmise on the Super Rod; authored Cramorant, Mantine and Finizen suit the inhabited shallows.

MAP_ROUTE132.why: Fast currents: keep Inclement Jellicent and Wailord, restore authored Barraskewda and Finizen, and retain the Horsea family through later rods.

MAP_ROUTE133.why: Western current return: retain Inclement Pelipper and Wailord; authored Dragalge and Mantine add coastal variety, with Skrelp available before its evolution.

MAP_ROUTE134.why: Deep current outlet: retain Inclement Jellicent and the Horsea line in fishing; authored Seel, Clamperl and Gorebyss distinguish Surf and preserve shellfish diversity.

MAP_SOOTOPOLIS_CITY.why: Enclosed crater lake: preserve Inclement Magikarp and Gyarados as the dominant family; authored Wishiwashi and Finizen add variety without importing the whole outer reef.

MAP_SEAFLOOR_CAVERN_ENTRANCE.why: Marine cave entrance: retain Inclement Tentacruel and Golbat, with authored Clamperl and Lanturn; Chinchou fishing develops the light-bearing cave resident.

MAP_SEAFLOOR_CAVERN_ROOM6.why: Fast cave water: keep Inclement Golbat among authored Frillish, Dragalge and Barraskewda; later fishing offers Kingdra and other strong marine residents.

MAP_SEAFLOOR_CAVERN_ROOM7.why: Deep cave pool: retain Inclement Tentacruel fishing while restoring authored Clamperl, Wishiwashi and both shellfish evolutions to distinguish the inner chamber.

MAP_SHOAL_CAVE_LOW_TIDE_ENTRANCE_ROOM.why: Cold cave entrance: retain Inclement Spheal and Lapras; authored Avalugg and Sealeo broaden the ice habitat, while native Slowpoke remains available by fishing.

MAP_SHOAL_CAVE_LOW_TIDE_INNER_ROOM.why: Inner cold pool: retain Inclement Golbat, Lapras and the Slowpoke family; authored Walrein and Clamperl distinguish this chamber from the entrance.

MAP_METEOR_FALLS_1F_1R.why: Meteor river entrance: preserve Inclement early Barboach/Dratini and the dragon family; authored Buizel and Whiscash supply river residents alongside the native cave bat.

MAP_METEOR_FALLS_1F_2R.why: Upper meteor pools: preserve Inclement Dratini and Lunatone cave identity; authored Basculin and Poliwhirl add river variety, with Lapras on later rods.

MAP_METEOR_FALLS_B1F_1R.why: Deep dragon pool: retain Inclement Dratini, Dragonair and Solrock identity; authored Basculin and Kingdra develop the late cave habitat.

MAP_METEOR_FALLS_B1F_2R.why: Quiet deep pool: retain Inclement Dratini fishing and cave Golbat; authored Slowpoke, Quagsire and Poliwhirl give the chamber a different freshwater roster.

MAP_PETALBURG_WOODS_3.why: Woodland pond: retain Inclement Poliwag/Slowpoke fishing and both final Poli evolutions; authored Lotad and Chewtle add forest-pond variety.

MAP_SAFARI_ZONE_NORTHWEST.why: Safari sludge habitat: preserve Inclement Alolan Grimer/Muk and ordinary Grimer/Muk access; authored Golduck remains a secondary pond resident.

MAP_SAFARI_ZONE_SOUTHEAST.why: Safari freshwater pool: preserve Inclement Wooper, Quagsire and the Dratini fishing family; authored Swanna and Chewtle add local diversity.

MAP_SAFARI_ZONE_SOUTHWEST.why: Safari marsh: preserve Inclement Stunfisk, Sliggoo and Seismitoad; authored Slowpoke complements the marsh, with freshwater fish on the rods.

MAP_SANDSTREWN_RUINS.why: Ancient isolated pool: retain Inclement Relicanth in every method and as the dominant Surf resident; authored Whiscash and Chewtle add limited freshwater variety.

MAP_SCORCHED_SLAB_B1F.why: Rocky underground pool: retain Inclement Golbat/Crobat and Barboach fishing; authored Slowbro and Gastrodon diversify the water without erasing the cave bats.

MAP_SEASPRAY_CAVE.why: Coastal cave: Tynamo keeps the electric-eel family at the local stage; preserve Inclement Quagsire and Wishiwashi/Krabby fishing while authored Binacle and Clamperl add shellfish.

MAP_ABANDONED_SHIP_HIDDEN_FLOOR_CORRIDOR.why: Submerged wreck: preserve Inclement Frillish/Skrelp fishing and Dhelmise; authored Dragalge broadens Surf without diluting the ghost-and-kelp habitat.

MAP_ABANDONED_SHIP_ROOMS_B1F.why: Flooded hull: retain Inclement Frillish/Skrelp fishing; restore authored Golisopod, Mareanie and Barbaracle as wreck-dwelling Surf residents.

MAP_ALTERING_CAVE_B1F.why: Unusual cave pool: keep Inclement western Gastrodon and Whiscash fishing; authored Basculegion, Jellicent and Malamar give this optional cavern its distinct roster.

MAP_VICTORY_ROAD_B2F.why: Final cave water: retain Inclement Dewgong, Lapras and Barboach/Basculin fishing; authored Floatzel and Dragonair add late-campaign options.
